title: Retrieval and similarity matching
purpose: Rank existing source items for a query representation under a declared similarity relation and an independent relevance rule.
boundary: Hx01 owns one retrieval operation, its contract, exact-search reference, relevance evidence and toolset. Retrieval takes a coordinate in a declared SpaceRef and returns ranked sources from a frozen corpus. Encoding is upstream: a text encoder, a kernel sample, or another producer may supply that coordinate, and the retrieval contract does not include the producer. Two methods share that corpus contract. Exact k-retrieval returns the k nearest sources under the declared metric and normalization. It is the registered tool and the fidelity baseline. Positive sparse combination retrieval approximates the same coordinate as a sparse non-negative combination of corpus vectors. Difference, shared residual, and cone constructors remain internal utilities and are not the retrieval strategy. The local profile consumes saved vectors from a named local encoder, including Hx15–Hx17, or a declared synthetic generator, and does not train an encoder. Hx18 owns the Gemini Embedding 2 provider, its adapter, credentials and response retention. An abstract corpus is a declared frozen population, separate from any concrete source population, and every entry keeps a source identity and parent lineage. The first abstract binding uses the local saved-vector profile and English text. Hubness and mean neighbor distance are diagnostics and do not close Hx02. Neighbors may feed Hx06 or a later Nonverba mapping; this operation does not state a contrast, an effect, or a Nonverba result. Generating text from a point is a separate operation. Hx14 owns shared admission, temporal integrity and the evidence ledger. Hx19 owns source loading.
summary: OR01-RET 0.1.0 takes a coordinate and returns the nearest saved sources under cosine or L2. That method is the registered tool. It passed its engineering checks on 30 October 2026, including [1, 0] ahead of [4, 0] under L2, and it refuses live calls and unbound relevance. Positive Sparse Combination Retrieval, OR01-COMB, solves non-negative least squares on the prepared corpus, repeats the minimum-weight refit until every survivor meets tau or none remain, and applies a fit floor and a path-length ceiling. Columns (1, 0) and (-0.2, 1) against target (0.45, 0.3) at tau 0.5 are empty, reason outside_cone. On 30 October 2026 make test-retrieval passed six combination checks. The registered tool does not link that solver, and the checks make no relevance claim. The active objective is geometric combination over the Open English WordNet noun hypernym interior: 17,191 abstract synsets, with 54,673 leaves kept outside that corpus. Exact k-retrieval stays the registered baseline and is not the active objective. The 29-term depth-3 binding remains the minimal historical population. On 31 October 2026 those 17,191 texts were encoded with the same EmbeddingGemma 2 text tower, and an exploratory probe called the current solver with gates fixed beforehand: tau 0.05, gamma 0.2, rho 3, kappa 1. That probe is not a closed run. The least-squares milestone remains the gate, because the face enumeration grows with the active-set width. Difference, shared residual, and cone constructors remain internal utilities. The 30 October geometric-query score on the English WordNet population stays indexed: the shared residual is inconclusive and the difference is negative. That score is not the current retrieval strategy. OR01-RET-ABS 0.1.0 still freezes that population and one local EmbeddingGemma 2 text SpaceRef. The general local and Gemini profile milestones stay proposed. No Gemini adapter is bound.

goals.title: Define the operation contract
goals.description: Define queries, searchable populations, relevance, source references, metric, ranking output and abstention conditions. OR01-RET 0.1.0 is that reusable contract. The text-Gemini profile and the local saved-vector profile are defined and unbound.

milestones.title: Specify inputs, outputs and requirements
milestones.description: OR01-RET 0.1.0 and OR01-RET-RER 0.1.0 define the ranked-retrieval interface, the two unbound profiles, and the checks an admitted run must apply. Authoring the contract admits no corpus and no run.
acceptance: OR01-RET 0.1.0 and OR01-RET-RER 0.1.0 specify input and output roles, claim scope, SpaceRef rules, ranking output, abstention and failure, and the two unbound profiles.
Each admitted profile must declare a frozen corpus snapshot, query eligibility, as-of policy, independent relevance, role pairs and exclusions. This revision selects no corpus and admits no run.

The text profile is Gemini Embedding 2 text input through the Hx18 provider record google-gemini-embedding-2. The local profile is saved vectors from a named encoder instance or a declared synthetic generator. Image, video, audio and PDF inputs stay unbound.

Pairwise similarity and kNN share the declared metric and normalization. Relevance is a separate declaration. Approximate-neighbor fidelity is specified against the exact reference and is not a relevance metric.
The contract states the record, temporal, data and admission checks an admitted run applies. The shared foundation validators remain proposed, so this revision does not call a shared implementation.

milestones.title: Bind the text-only Gemini retrieval profile
milestones.description: Name the frozen text corpus, queries, independent relevance rule, lexical baseline, requested dimensions and task role for gemini-embedding-2. This binding is one of the two profiles. It does not authorize a live API call.
acceptance: The binding names gemini-embedding-2 through the Hx18 provider record google-gemini-embedding-2, text inputs only, the requested dimensions and normalization, the task or role pair, and the SpaceRef rule. Image, video, audio and PDF inputs are outside this profile.

It names a frozen text corpus snapshot, query eligibility, as-of policy, source identities, an independent relevance rule and a lexical baseline on the same eligible texts. Relevance is not the embedding distance used to rank.
It links OR01-RET and OR01-RET-RER for this profile. It does not authorize a live API call, select credentials or claim that the Hx18 adapter exists.

A hosted model ID is not an immutable checkpoint. The binding states how any returned revision, request configuration and response artifacts will be retained, and that replay of saved responses is distinct from a fresh call.

milestones.title: Bind the local saved-vector profile
milestones.description: Name one frozen snapshot of saved vectors, its encoder checkpoint or synthetic generator, and an independent relevance rule. This profile does not wait on the Hx18 adapter and does not authorize encoder training.
acceptance: The binding names one SpaceRef: encoder or generator identity, revision, dimensions, normalization, metric and task or role pair. Equal length alone is not acceptance.
It names a frozen vector snapshot, the source inputs those vectors came from, query eligibility, as-of or non-temporal mode, and the exclusion rules.
The relevance rule is hand-adjudicated regimes or a synthetic motif rule, fixed before ranking, plus a baseline on the same eligible queries and corpus. The ranking distance is not that rule.
The binding links OR01-RET and OR01-RET-RER. It selects no Gemini request and admits no run by itself.

goals.title: Provide a reference implementation
goals.description: Exact search and the OR01-RET engineering envelope are recorded. The tool returns the nearest saved sources under cosine or L2 and does not call Gemini. Approximate-index fidelity remains proposed.

milestones.title: Rank saved vectors with exact search
milestones.description: The C++ reference returns the nearest caller-supplied sources under cosine or L2, with optional L2 normalization, source-ID ties, reported exclusions, pairwise similarity and leave-one-out neighborhood diagnostics. The comparison happens in embedding coordinates. The 30 October 2026 container check passed seven engineering checks. This is not a relevance result.
acceptance: The reference ranks saved vectors with cosine and L2, normalization none and L2, deterministic source-ID ties and reported self-match, exclusion and undefined-geometry skips.
Empty, abstained and failed stay distinct. A mismatched space or snapshot binding, a duplicate source ID, a non-finite value and k of zero are rejected.
Pairwise similarity uses the same geometry as search. Hubness and mean neighbor distance are leave-one-out diagnostics and do not close Hx02.
make test-retrieval passed seven checks on 30 October 2026 under g++ with -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic. The fixture does not call a provider, judge relevance or register a tool.

milestones.title: Wrap exact search in the operation envelope
milestones.description: OR01-RET 0.1.0 is registered on the common check and run boundary. It returns the nearest saved sources through the exact-search reference and retains run identity, SpaceRef, code and configuration hashes, and the fitted-artifact id. The 30 October 2026 container check passed nine engineering checks, and a visible run confirmed the L2 and cosine order on two synthetic fixtures. Live calls and relevance claims are refused. This is not a relevance result.
acceptance: Conformance tests exercise the declared role and SpaceRef relationship, applicable temporal checks, malformed or unsupported inputs, stale fitted artifacts and explicit failure propagation; no rejected record becomes an ordinary vector or unreported omission.

Outputs retain parent and source lineage, representation kind, OperationRun identity, code and configuration identity and fitted-artifact identities. Engineering fixtures stay labeled engineering-only and do not establish operation quality.

The envelope calls the exact-search reference for metric, normalization, deterministic tie handling and source IDs before any approximate index is judged. A legitimate empty result remains distinct from execution failure.
A provider call, credential handling and Gemini response retention stay with Hx18. The local profile reads saved vectors.

milestones.title: Judge an approximate index against exact search
milestones.description: When an approximate index is introduced, measure it against the exact reference on the same eligible corpus. Those figures are not relevance metrics. OR01-RET 0.1.0 contains no approximate index.
acceptance: Report recall of the exact reference neighbor set at the same k, and the distribution of approximation loss, on the same snapshot, exclusions and SpaceRef.
Keep that fidelity report separate from precision, recall, nDCG or MRR against the independent relevance rule.
Reject a stale or incompatible index and query pair. Do not replace the exact reference with the approximate ranking when reporting fidelity.

goals.title: Evaluate admitted retrieval profiles
goals.description: Run relevance evaluations only after a profile is bound and the operation envelope exists. The text profile waits on the Hx18 adapter. The local profile does not. Engineering checks of exact search do not complete either evaluation.

milestones.title: Run the admitted Gemini text retrieval test
milestones.description: Run the bound text-only Gemini Embedding 2 test. Evaluate relevance and cost against the declared lexical baseline. Freeze the protocol, baselines and failure criteria before held-out assessment. This record does not authorize a live call.
acceptance: The admitted protocol fixes data partitions, instance and artifact identities, baselines, budgets, selection policy, metrics and failure criteria before held-out assessment. Diagnostic exposure, changes and repeated looks are indexed; a revised protocol does not silently reuse an exposed confirmation set.

Report the declared evaluation unit, uncertainty or its justified limitation, coverage including abstentions and failures, and relevant resource costs. Index every initiated run and its outcome under foundations-evidence-ledger; do not discard unsuccessful or inconclusive evidence.

A valid completed evaluation can be negative or inconclusive. Milestone completion is not a positive claim verdict, and invalid or unexecuted attempts alone cannot satisfy operation-quality evaluation acceptance.

Measure relevance against independent labels or a declared external rule, not the embedding distance used to rank candidates. Preserve the same eligible corpus, input information and query population for the lexical baseline.

The population is the text-only Gemini Embedding 2 binding. Other modalities and other encoders are outside this run. Saved-response replay and a fresh provider call remain distinct evidence, and neither closes the Hx18 multimodal fixture.

milestones.title: Run the admitted local saved-vector test
milestones.description: Run the bound local snapshot through the operation envelope. Relevance uses the hand-adjudicated or synthetic rule fixed in the binding, and a baseline on the same queries and corpus. This test does not call Gemini.
acceptance: The admitted protocol fixes the saved-vector snapshot, SpaceRef, partitions, baseline, metrics and failure criteria before held-out assessment. The exact-search engineering checks do not satisfy this milestone.
Measure relevance against the bound independent rule. Report coverage, abstentions, failures and the evaluation unit. Retain negative and inconclusive outcomes.
The population is the local saved-vector binding. A result here does not transfer to Gemini, to another encoder, or to a causal claim in Hx06.

goals.title: Expose Hx01 capabilities as a reusable toolset
goals.description: Expose developed retrieval components through the common discover, configure, check, run and inspect boundary. OR01-RET 0.1.0 is registered for exploratory saved-vector exact search. Pairwise similarity, neighborhood diagnostics, and geometric operators stay outside that surface until this goal admits them. The text-Gemini and local profiles stay explicit.

milestones.title: Define the public toolset surface and coverage
milestones.description: Map query and corpus admission, exact search, pairwise similarity, kNN, exclusions and result inspection into public components. Approximate search stays outside the surface until its fidelity milestone is admitted.
acceptance: Inventory implemented and selected future public capabilities, their owning components, contracts, request and result schemas, reusable APIs, composition points, gaps and claim levels; distinguish the exact-search reference from proposed work.

The surface specifies query and document roles, frozen corpus and index identities, geometry, normalization, deterministic tie behavior, source IDs and self-match or overlap exclusions; empty results, abstention and execution failure remain distinct.

Specify discover, configure, check, run and inspect behavior for the local saved-vector profile and the text-Gemini profile, declaring required roles, SpaceRefs, geometry and dependencies without assuming a universal vector shape.

evidence.label: Common tool calling contract and API boundary; design reference

milestones.title: Expose and verify the agreed tools and workflows
milestones.description: Expose the agreed building blocks and composed workflows through the common command-line and reusable API boundary, keeping operation logic with its owning component and retaining inspectable results.
acceptance: Verify the agreed query-to-ranked-source workflow and independently callable components, including stale or incompatible index rejection, exclusion rules and deterministic ranking behavior. Approximate-search fidelity and independently measured application relevance retain separate evidence claims.

CLI and reusable API examples and conformance checks cover compatible provider interchange and explicit incompatibility, malformed input, failure and abstention; retain source and parent lineage, configuration, fitted-artifact identities and complete outcome accounting.

Record implemented coverage, remaining gaps and evidence for each agreed public capability and composed workflow. Reusable engineering checks do not authorize paused research or establish operation quality; new experimental claims retain their own admitted contracts, protocols and permissions.

goals.title: Rank a frozen corpus from a target coordinate
goals.description: Retrieval takes a coordinate in a declared SpaceRef. Encoding that coordinate from text or another raw input is upstream. Exact k-retrieval is the registered baseline and is not the active objective. The active objective is positive sparse combination over the noun hypernym interior, 17,191 English abstract synsets. The 29-term depth-3 binding stays the minimal historical population. The six combination checks passed on 30 October 2026, including the tau witness that drops a refit below tau. The least-squares milestone gates a run on the interior. Difference, shared residual, and cone constructors remain internal utilities and are not the retrieval strategy. The English abstract population is one frozen corpus, separate from any concrete source population. Ranking distance, combination weights, and the residual are not the relevance rule. This goal introduces no approximate index, live call, or encoder training.

milestones.title: Bind a minimal abstract concept corpus
milestones.description: OR01-RET-ABS 0.1.0 freezes an English Open English WordNet 2025 population: 10 pinned concrete noun synsets, their hypernyms at depth 1 through 3 (29 abstract entries), and the shared-principle labels for sets of two or three seeds. Seven of 165 query sets are eligible for task association. The concrete seeds stay outside the abstract corpus. The local saved-vector profile is selected. The SpaceRef is google/embeddinggemma-2 revision f9972ac22e696a105c482202646979e33e4b5a1e, text only, 768 dimensions, L2 normalization, cosine, and the sentence-similarity prompt. Saved-vector hashes are in the binding. The bytes stay outside Git. The binding admits no live call, encoder training, or relevance result.
acceptance: The binding names the ontology subset, the extraction rule, and the seed list. The population is English text. A multilingual expansion waits on explicit alignment diagnostics.
It declares one SpaceRef: encoder or generator identity, revision, dimensions, normalization, metric, and task or role pair. Equal length alone is not acceptance.

It freezes the text snapshot and the corresponding saved vectors. Every abstract entry keeps a source identity and parent lineage, such as an ontology term, path, relation, or extraction rule. The abstract population is separate from any concrete source population.

It declares an independent relevance rule, hand-adjudicated or a synthetic shared-principle label linking abstract statements to concrete pairs, plus exclusions and query eligibility. Ranking distance is not that rule.
The binding uses the local saved-vector profile and links OR01-RET and OR01-RET-RER. It does not authorize a live call, encoder training, or a relevance result.

evidence.label: Exploratory neighborhood listing, not a relevance result

milestones.title: Define geometric query constructors
milestones.description: Deprecated as a retrieval strategy on 30 October 2026. The functions remain internal utilities. They build the difference of two points, the shared residual after removing that difference span, and a cone with a unit axis, an angular aperture, and optional radial bounds. Ranking inside the cone calls exact k-retrieval. On 30 October 2026, make test-retrieval passed the seven exact-search checks and two constructor checks under g++ with -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic. The registered tool links only the ranker. This is not a relevance result, and no abstract corpus is bound by these checks.
acceptance: The operators are pure deterministic functions of the input vectors and the declared parameters. They return a SpaceRef-compatible query vector, a direction, or cone parameters. Ranking inside the resulting neighborhood uses the existing exact-search metric, normalization, and source-ID tie rules.
Non-finite values, collinear inputs, a zero norm, undefined geometry, and a mismatched SpaceRef refuse or skip with an explicit report. Empty, abstained, and failed stay distinct.
Engineering checks use synthetic fixtures in the style of the recorded [1, 0] and [0, 1] cases. The checks call no provider and judge no relevance.

Leave-one-out hubness, mean neighbor distance inside the cone, and cone purity are reported diagnostics. They do not close Hx02, Hx06, or a Nonverba evaluation. Generating text from a geometric point stays a separate operation.

milestones.title: Evaluate abstract retrieval under geometric queries
milestones.description: Historical score of the deprecated geometric-query interpretation. It is not the current retrieval strategy. OR01-RET-ABS-EVAL 0.1.0 scores the seven eligible WordNet queries under the frozen shared-principle rule. Full-list binary nDCG is 0.688317949329 for the point baseline, 0.421848381196 for the lexical baseline, and 0.662943315673 for the shared residual. The protocol calls the shared residual inconclusive and the difference negative. Cone aperture 0 is empty for every query. Apertures pi/3 and wider keep the whole corpus. The result is this population and this EmbeddingGemma 2 text SpaceRef only.
acceptance: The protocol fixes partitions, SpaceRef, the plain exact-neighbor baseline, the metrics against the independent shared-principle labels, and the failure criteria before held-out assessment. nDCG or precision may be those metrics. Ranking distance, cone membership, and the geometric construction are not the relevance rule.
The report covers cone queries and point queries, abstentions, failures, and the evaluation unit. Negative and inconclusive outcomes stay indexed.

The population is the bound English abstract corpus on the local saved-vector profile. A result here does not transfer to Gemini, to another encoder, to a Nonverba evaluation, or to a causal claim in Hx06.

evidence.label: Abstract retrieval score, inconclusive and negative

milestones.title: Specify positive sparse combination retrieval
milestones.description: OR01-COMB approximates a prepared target coordinate as a sparse non-negative linear combination of prepared corpus vectors. The solver is non-negative least squares, followed by a refit down to a declared minimum weight. The refit repeats until every surviving weight is at least tau or no column remains. Columns (1, 0) and (-0.2, 1) against target (0.45, 0.3) at tau 0.5 finish empty, reason outside_cone, because the refit of the first column is 0.45. A fit floor requires the reconstruction cosine to meet gamma. A directness ceiling empties a combination whose path length over net length exceeds rho. An early cosine stop returns the rank-1 neighbor with its one-vector weight. On 30 October 2026 make test-retrieval passed six combination checks under g++ with -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic. The registered tool does not link the solver. Claim level stays exploratory. The residual and the weights are not a relevance rule.
acceptance: The method takes a coordinate in the declared SpaceRef and a frozen corpus. Source-space encoding is upstream and outside the retrieval contract. Exact k-retrieval remains the registered tool and the fidelity baseline.

The solver is non-negative least squares on vectors prepared by the same prepare() as exact search. A minimum weight tau is fixed beforehand. Columns below tau are dropped and the solve is refit on the survivors. The output includes the selected source identities and their positive weights, ordered by descending weight and then ascending source ID.

Weights are non-negative. The combination step does not subtract a corpus vector and does not negate a coordinate. Negation is available only when the corpus already contains that text. Identical columns resolve to the fewest positive weights, then the lexicographically smallest source-ID list.

The fit floor gamma requires ||Xw|| / ||t|| to meet gamma. That ratio is the reconstruction cosine and is a floor. The directness ceiling rho, at least 1, empties a solution whose path length divided by ||Xw|| exceeds rho. If the rank-1 exact-search cosine meets kappa, the result is that neighbor with the one-vector weight. A zero target abstains. All-zero weights are empty.

Engineering checks use synthetic fixtures: a one-direction sum that passes both gates, a rank-1 neighbor returned with its one-vector weight, a short combination that passes both gates, a path ratio above rho with outcome empty and reason directness, a target outside the cone with outcome empty, and the tau witness above. The checks call no provider, introduce no approximate index, and judge no relevance.

milestones.title: Harden the combination least-squares step
milestones.description: The active-set solver forms the normal equations, so the condition number of the Gram matrix is squared. An entering column whose pivot fails, or which the line search ejects, is blocked for the rest of that call. The six fixtures and a small brute-force probe, through 10 columns, did not show a wrong residual. The geometric run needs this step to be safe at the noun hypernym interior: 17,191 prepared columns in 768 dimensions. This milestone replaces that least-squares step and lets an ejected column enter again when a later gradient is positive. It does not score a corpus, register a combination command, call Gemini, or add an approximate index. gamma, rho, tau, and kappa stay declared by the caller and are not chosen from WordNet weights. Early stop still skips the gates. combine() takes a bare target vector, so a second SpaceRef is not checked. An undefined prepared column is still dropped with no skip record, and a corpus of undefined columns is still empty, reason outside_cone.
acceptance: The unconstrained step uses a factorization that does not form the normal equations. Rank deficiency stays an explicit failure of that step.

A column removed by the line search can enter again on a later iteration when its reduced gradient is positive. A synthetic fixture forces a column out of the passive set, and the residual on that fixture matches an independent non-negative subset solve.
make test-retrieval still passes the existing combination checks, including columns (1, 0) and (-0.2, 1) against target (0.45, 0.3) at tau 0.5, with outcome empty and reason outside_cone.
The registered tool still links only exact search. The milestone calls no provider, scores no corpus, and adds no approximate index.

milestones.title: Bind the noun hypernym interior
milestones.description: OR01-RET-ABS 0.2.0 freezes the English noun hypernym interior of Open English WordNet 2025. A noun synset is abstract when at least one other noun synset names it as a hypernym. The freeze holds 17,191 abstract entries. 54,673 leaves stay outside. instance_hypernym is excluded. Every entry keeps its synset id, members, definition, ILI, lexfile, depth from entity, and direct hypernym parents. The 0.1.0 snapshot of 29 depth-3 entries is unchanged. This revision admits no run and stores no vectors.
acceptance: The extraction rule is noun hypernym only. A synset enters the corpus when another noun synset names it as a hypernym. Leaves stay outside. instance_hypernym is excluded.
The frozen text has 17,191 abstract entries from 71,864 noun synsets, each with source identity and direct hypernym parent lineage. The population is English.
OR01-RET-ABS 0.1.0 stays the minimal ten-seed population. Its snapshot sha256 is unchanged. This revision does not admit a relevance result, a vector file, or a live call.

milestones.title: Encode the noun hypernym interior
milestones.description: Saved vectors for the 17,191 interior texts use the same EmbeddingGemma 2 text tower, prompt, surface, L2 normalization, and cosine metric as OR01-RET-ABS 0.1.0. The snapshot id is or01-ret-abs-0.2.0-local-text. The 0.1.0 vector hashes stayed in place. Ten noun-leaf queries were encoded beside the corpus and are not rows of it. No relevance claim follows from the vectors.
acceptance: The encode uses google/embeddinggemma-2 revision f9972ac22e696a105c482202646979e33e4b5a1e, text tower only, 768 dimensions, prompt task: sentence similarity | query: , and the surface of the first member and the first definition.
The saved file has 17,191 rows, one per interior source id, under a new snapshot id. The 0.1.0 concrete and abstract vector hashes are unchanged.
Model weights and vector bytes stay outside Git. The encode does not train the model and does not rank neighbors.

milestones.title: Run combination on the noun hypernym interior
milestones.description: This is the geometric retrieval run. A noun leaf, outside the interior, is the target coordinate. OR01-COMB writes a non-negative combination of the 17,191 abstract entries. Exact k-retrieval is not this run. The claim level is exploratory_description. gamma, rho, tau, and kappa are declared before the run and are not chosen from the weights. The interior vectors exist. The run still waits on the least-squares step being safe at this width. An exploratory probe on 31 October 2026 called the current solver and is not this milestone.
acceptance: Each query is a noun leaf and is not a member of the interior. The corpus is the encoded 17,191-entry interior under its declared SpaceRef.
The method is positive sparse combination. The result lists source identities and positive weights. Weights and the residual are not a relevance rule.
The gates are fixed before any interior result is inspected. Empty, abstained, and failed stay distinct. The run does not call Gemini, register a combination tool, or add an approximate index.
